description: This file defines the enum class PolicyLifecycle, representing different states in a Policy's lifecycle (ACTIVE and DELETED), along with a method to retrieve a lifecycle enum value based on a string name.

classes.name: PolicyLifecycle
classes.description: An enumeration of a Policy's lifecycle states: ACTIVE and DELETED, with a static method for lookup by name.

methods.name: forName
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the PolicyLifecycle enum corresponding to the given name string, or empty if no match is found.
